title: Revert if supply is less than premint parameter
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `getTokensNeededToAddEthValue` function reverts if the `supply` is less than the `curve`'s `premint` parameter.  ``` function getTokensNeededToAddEthValue(uint256 supply, uint256 ethAmount, bytes32 curveParameters) external pure returns (uint256 tokenAmount) {     (uint256 m, uint256 p) = decodeParameters(curveParameters);     UD60x18 pmins = ud(supply - p); } ```  I will describe the scenario where the `supply` is smaller than the `curve`'s `premint` parameter.
